title: openEHR Data Types Information Model
description: OOJS representation of the openEHR RM data_types package (RM Release 1.1.0). Covers the basic, text, quantity, date_time, time_specification, encapsulated, and uri packages.

DATA_VALUE.description: Abstract parent of all DV_ data value types.

DV_BOOLEAN.description: Items which are truly boolean data, such as true/false or yes/no answers.

DV_STATE.description: For representing state values which obey a defined state machine. The state name is a coded term; is_terminal indicates whether no further transitions are possible.

DV_IDENTIFIER.description: Type for representing identifiers of real-world entities such as drivers licence numbers, social security numbers, prescription ids, etc.

issuer.description: Optional authority which issues the kind of id.

assigner.description: Optional organisation that assigned the id.

type.description: Optional identifier type, e.g. 'prescription', 'Social Security Number'.

CODE_PHRASE.description: A fully coordinated term from a terminology service, identified by a terminology_id and a code_string.

code_string.description: The key used by the terminology service to identify a concept.

preferred_term.description: Optional preferred term corresponding to the code_string.

TERM_MAPPING.description: A coded term mapped to a DV_TEXT, with a match qualifier indicating the relative breadth of the mapping ('>', '=', '<', '?').

match.description: Relative match: '>' broader, '=' equivalent, '<' narrower, '?' unknown.

purpose.description: Optional purpose of the mapping, e.g. 'billing', 'interoperability'.

target.description: The target term of the mapping.

DV_TEXT.description: A text item, which may optionally be coded. The primary content is the value string; optional attributes carry formatting hints, hyperlinks, terminology mappings, and language/charset metadata.

hyperlink.description: Deprecated: optional web link associated with the text.

mappings.description: Optional list of mappings to coded terms in other terminologies.

language.description: Optional language of the text value, coded from openEHR Code Set 'languages'.

charset.description: Optional character encoding scheme, coded from openEHR Code Set 'character sets'.

DV_CODED_TEXT.description: A text item whose value is the rubric of a controlled terminology term. The code is held in defining_code.

defining_code.description: The term of which the value attribute is the textual rendition.

DV_PARAGRAPH.description: DEPRECATED: use markdown-formatted DV_TEXT instead. A composite text value consisting of a series of DV_TEXT items forming a paragraph.

DV_ORDERED.description: Abstract class for data value types that have a defined ordering. Provides optional normal_status, normal_range, and other_reference_ranges.

normal_status.description: Optional normal status indicator coded from openEHR 'normal_status' group (HHH, HH, H, N, L, LL, LLL).

DV_INTERVAL.description: Generic interval of a comparable DV_ORDERED type. Represents a contiguous subrange with optional lower/upper bounds and unbounded flags. The lower and upper values, when present, must be instances of the same concrete DV_ORDERED subtype.

lower.description: Lower bound; absent when lower_unbounded is true.

upper.description: Upper bound; absent when upper_unbounded is true.

lower_unbounded.description: True if the interval is unbounded below.

upper_unbounded.description: True if the interval is unbounded above.

lower_included.description: True if the lower bound is included in the interval.

upper_included.description: True if the upper bound is included in the interval.

REFERENCE_RANGE.description: A named range associated with a DV_ORDERED datum, e.g. 'normal', 'critical', 'therapeutic'.

meaning.description: Term indicating the meaning of this range.

range.description: The data range for this meaning.

DV_ORDINAL.description: Integral score values with implied ordering but no assumption of equal spacing between values. Examples: Apgar, Glasgow Coma Scale.

symbol.description: Coded textual representation of this value in the enumeration.

value.description: Integer value in the ordered enumeration.

DV_SCALE.description: Scale values with implied ordering, no assumption of equal spacing, and non-integer values allowed. Example: Borg CR 10 scale.

symbol.description: Coded textual representation of this scale value.

value.description: Real number value of the scale item.

DV_QUANTIFIED.description: Abstract class for quantified data values that have a numeric magnitude and an optional magnitude_status qualifier.

magnitude_status.description: Optional status: '=' exact, '<' less than, '>' greater than, '<=' less than or equal, '>=' greater than or equal, '~' approximately equal.

DV_AMOUNT.description: Abstract class for relative quantities that can be added or subtracted. Provides accuracy as a Real value and an accuracy_is_percent flag.

accuracy.description: Accuracy of the value. -1 means unknown. 0 means 100% accurate.

accuracy_is_percent.description: If true, accuracy is expressed as a percentage; otherwise as an absolute value.

DV_QUANTITY.description: A quantity with a real-number magnitude and scientific units (UCUM by default). Used for measurable physical quantities.

units.description: Units code, e.g. 'kg/m^2', 'mm[Hg]', 'ms-1'. UCUM case-sensitive form by default.

precision.description: Number of decimal places. 0 = integral; -1 = unlimited.

units_system.description: Optional URI identifying the units system when not UCUM.

units_display_name.description: Optional displayable form of the units, e.g. '°C'.

DV_COUNT.description: Countable quantities such as number of pregnancies or steps. Not for physical entities that have units.

DV_PROPORTION.description: A ratio of two real numbers. The type attribute controls the semantic kind of proportion (ratio, unitary, percent, fraction, integer fraction).

denominator.description: Denominator of the ratio. Must not be 0.

precision.description: Optional decimal places for numerator and denominator. 0 = integral; -1 = unlimited.

DV_ABSOLUTE_QUANTITY.description: Abstract class for quantities whose values are absolute with respect to an origin. Dates and times are the primary examples. The accuracy attribute is a DV_AMOUNT.

accuracy.description: Optional accuracy expressed as a differential amount.

DV_TEMPORAL.description: Abstract temporal variant of DV_ABSOLUTE_QUANTITY whose diff type is DV_DURATION.

accuracy.description: Optional time accuracy expressed as a duration.

DV_DATE.description: An absolute point in time specified to the day, as an ISO 8601 date string. Partial dates (year only, or year+month) are allowed.

DV_TIME.description: An absolute point in time from the start of the current day, specified to a fraction of a second, as an ISO 8601 time string.

DV_DATE_TIME.description: An absolute point in time specified to the second, as an ISO 8601 date-time string.

DV_DURATION.description: A period of time relative to a notional point. ISO 8601 duration string with two openEHR extensions: a leading '-' for negative durations, and 'W' may be mixed with other designators.

DV_TIME_SPECIFICATION.description: Abstract class for all timing specifications. Specifies points in time, possibly linked to the calendar or a real-world repeating event.

value.description: The specification in HL7v3 PIVL or EIVL syntax.

DV_PERIODIC_TIME_SPECIFICATION.description: Specifies periodic points in time, phase-linked to the calendar or event-linked to a real-world repeating event. Based on HL7v3 PIVL<T> and EIVL<T>. The value formalism must be 'HL7:PIVL' or 'HL7:EIVL'.

DV_GENERAL_TIME_SPECIFICATION.description: Specifies points in time using the HL7v3 GTS general time specification syntax.

DV_ENCAPSULATED.description: Abstract class defining common metadata for all encapsulated data types whose internal structure is defined outside the EHR model.

charset.description: Optional character encoding scheme, coded from openEHR Code Set 'character sets'.

language.description: Optional language of the data, coded from openEHR Code Set 'languages'.

DV_MULTIMEDIA.description: Encapsulated audiovisual or bio-signal data. Content may be stored inline (data) or by reference (uri), or both.

alternate_text.description: Text to display in lieu of multimedia display/replay.

uri.description: URI reference to externally stored content.

data.description: Inline content encoded as a Base64 string (represents Array<Byte>).

media_type.description: IANA MIME media type, coded from openEHR Code Set 'media types'.

compression_algorithm.description: Optional compression algorithm, coded from openEHR integrity check code set.

integrity_check.description: Optional binary cryptographic integrity checksum, Base64-encoded.

integrity_check_algorithm.description: Type of integrity check, coded from openEHR integrity check code set.

size.description: Original size in bytes of unencoded data.

DV_PARSABLE.description: Encapsulated data expressed as a parsable string. The formalism attribute names the syntax, e.g. 'json', 'xml', 'GLIF 1.0'.

DV_URI.description: A reference to an object conforming to RFC-3986 URI syntax. Plain-text URIs (with unencoded characters) are allowed for readability but must be encoded before use in machine contexts.

DV_EHR_URI.description: A DV_URI with scheme 'ehr', used to reference items within openEHR EHRs. Syntax: ehr://system_id/ehr_id/... or ehr:/ehr_id/...
